name: outcomes-one-task
input: One run fits the existing task T86 in work stream WS04. It produces five outcomes: read a thread, reply, place an order, change an address, and record a payment. Where does the run go, where do the five outcomes go, and how many new tasks do you create? Answer in three short lines. End with: New tasks: <n>
note: One job has five record outcomes, not five tasks.
